  v.composer AS veyyil_composer,
  v.release_year AS veyyil_year,
  MIN(fc.release_year) AS first_film_year,
  ash.film AS ash_film,
  ash.composer AS ash_film_composer
FROM
  (SELECT 'Veyyil' AS film, composer, release_year FROM films WHERE title = 'Veyyil') v
JOIN
  (SELECT f.title AS film, c.name AS composer
   FROM films f
   JOIN composers c ON f.composer_id = c.id
   WHERE f.title IN (
     SELECT film_title FROM cast WHERE actor_name = 'Ashrita Shetty'
   )
  ) ash ON v.composer = ash.composer
JOIN
  films fc ON fc.composer_id = (SELECT id FROM composers WHERE name = v.composer)
GROUP BY
  v.composer, v.release_year, ash.film, ash.composer
HAVING
  v.release_year = MIN(fc.release_year);
